values: 生成光环，对周围友军提供增益。自身对敌人造成足够伤害时将可治疗光环内的友军。
Mikola generates a Courage Sphere and provides buffs for nearby allies. Upon dealing sufficient damage, she heals all allies within range.
生成一个跟随自己的半径2格的无畏光环，使其中的友军提高40点急速和10点远程防御，自己额外提升30点急速和10点远程防御。当曼卡拉在光环存在期间累计对敌人造成相当于自身初始攻击力300%的伤害时，产生一道治愈音波，为光环内的所有友军恢复-80% − 10% ATK生命值。无畏光环持续10秒。

Mikola generates a 2-tile Courage Sphere that follows her around, increasing Haste by 40 and Ranged DEF by 10 for all allies within range, while increasing her own Haste by 30 and Ranged DEF by 10. When Mikola deals total damage equal to 300% of her initial ATK while Courage Sphere is around, a Healing Wave will emerge, restoring -80% − 10% ATK HP to all allies within range. Courage Sphere lasts for 10s.
治愈音波恢复的生命值提高至-90% − 10% ATK。
Increases the healing amount of Healing Wave to -90% − 10% ATK.
无畏光环的持续时间延长至12秒。
Increases the duration of Courage Sphere to 12s.
治愈音波恢复的生命值提高至-100% − 10% ATK。
Increases the healing amount of Healing Wave to -100% − 10% ATK.
治愈音波恢复的生命值提高至-110% − 10% ATK。
Increases the healing amount of Healing Wave to -110% − 10% ATK.
在战场中央生成荣耀擂台，己方夺取其控制权后获得全队增益。
Mikola generates an Honor Arena in the center of the battlefield and provides buffs for all allies after her side gains control of the arena.

战斗开始时，在战场中央生成一座横跨战场的荣耀擂台，持续至战斗结束。当荣耀擂台范围内的敌我其中一方的单位数量超过另一方时，便会开始抢夺荣耀擂台，并在维持人数优势3秒后获得荣耀擂台的控制权。
当己方控制荣耀擂台时，己方全体单位提升14% + 1%攻击力，并且每秒恢复-12% − 2% ATK生命值。

Mikola generates an Honor Arena spanning the battlefield when a battle starts, lasting until the battle ends. The side with more units within the arena will gain control of it after maintaining the advantage for 3s.
Mikola restores all allies' HP by -12% − 2% ATK per second and increases their ATK by 14% + 1% when her side gains control of the Honor Arena.
当己方控制荣耀擂台时，己方获得的攻击力加成提高至16% + 1%。
Increases all allies' ATK by 16% + 1% when Mikola's side gains control of the Honor Arena.
当己方控制荣耀擂台时，己方获得的攻击力加成提高至18% + 1%。
Increases all allies' ATK by 18% + 1% when Mikola's side gains control of the Honor Arena.
当己方控制荣耀擂台时，己方获得的攻击力加成提高至20% + 1%。
Increases all allies' ATK by 20% + 1% when Mikola's side gains control of the Honor Arena.
为自己和两名友军恢复生命，并暂时提高护甲与魔抗。
Mikola restores HP and temporarily increases Phys & Magic DEF for herself and the two weakest allies.
摇晃铃铛，为自己和另外2名最虚弱的友军恢复-130% − 20% ATK生命值，并使其护甲与魔抗提高40%，持续5秒。
Mikola rings her bell, restoring -130% − 20% ATK HP and increasing Phys & Magic DEF by 40% for herself and the 2 weakest allies for 5s.
本技能恢复的生命值提高至-150% − 20% ATK。
Increases HP recovery amount to -150% − 20% ATK.
本技能恢复的生命值提高至-170% − 20% ATK。
Increases HP recovery amount to -170% − 20% ATK.
本技能恢复的生命值提高至-190% − 20% ATK。
Increases HP recovery amount to -190% − 20% ATK.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升9%，且当己方控制荣耀擂台时，自身的攻击力额外提升6%。
Mikola increases her ATK by 9% during battle. She gains an extra 6% ATK when her side gains control of the Honor Arena.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升12%，且当己方控制荣耀擂台时，自身的攻击力额外提升8%。
Mikola increases her ATK by 12% during battle. She gains an extra 8% ATK when her side gains control of the Honor Arena.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升15%，且当己方控制荣耀擂台时，自身的攻击力额外提升10%。
Mikola increases her ATK by 15% during battle. She gains an extra 10% ATK when her side gains control of the Honor Arena.
无畏光环持续一定时间后将获得强化，对光环内友军周围的敌人持续造成伤害。
Mikola enhances her Courage Sphere after some time and deals continuous damage to enemies adjacent to allies within the Courage Sphere.
当无畏光环单次累计持续6秒后，光环会获得强化：使光环内除自身以外的其他所有友方英雄获得“战斗怒火”效果，每秒对其周围1格范围内的敌人造成相当于曼卡拉攻击力50%的伤害。该强化效果会在光环结束后重置。

Mikola enhances her Courage Sphere after it has been active for 6s, granting Combat Fury to all allied heroes (except herself) within range, and dealing damage equal to 50% of her ATK per second to enemies adjacent to these allies. The enhancements reset when the Courage Sphere disappears.
受“战斗怒火”影响的友军，每秒对邻近敌人造成的伤害提高至曼卡拉攻击力的60%。
Increases Mikola's damage dealt per second to enemies adjacent to allies carrying Combat Fury to 60% of her ATK.
受“战斗怒火”影响的友军还会提升30点受愈。
Increases 30 Vitality for allies carrying Combat Fury.
受“战斗怒火”影响的友军，每秒对邻近敌人造成的伤害提高至曼卡拉攻击力的70%。
Increases Mikola's damage dealt per second to enemies adjacent to allies carrying Combat Fury to 70% of her ATK.
当己方控制荣耀擂台时，无畏光环的持续时间不会减少。
Mikola's Courage Sphere remains unaffected in duration if her side gains control of the Honor Arena.
当己方控制荣耀擂台时，无畏光环的持续时间不会减少。
Mikola's Courage Sphere remains unaffected in duration if her side gains control of the Honor Arena.
